source_context_translations.translation: The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical route along which people or things travel.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Concrete spatial sense, distinguished from the philosophical principle.
additional_senses.Register (English): Early literary Chinese; formal and literary
Sentence Translations (English): The great road is very level, yet the people like bypaths.
Traveling along the road, he went slowly, and his heart felt estranged.
The road is difficult and long; when shall we meet?
The exemplary person follows the road and acts without missing the right time.
Sentences: 君子遵道而行，不失其時。

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To express something in words or explain it verbally to another person.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): The verb denotes verbal articulation rather than following a way or practicing a principle.
additional_senses.Register (English): Early literary Chinese; formal and literary
Sentence Translations (English): I ask to explain the reason.
You explain the changes from antiquity to the present.
The historian relates the ruler's virtue.
My teaching to people has been established for a long time.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental course or principle by which things exist and unfold; here, the Way that can be spoken of is not constant.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): This occurrence is the cosmological and philosophical Way, not merely a method or road.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Laozi base text in the received Wang Bi recension; philosophical and literary

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Marks a judgment that something qualifies as, or may properly be treated as, a specified category or description.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): This evaluative use presents a classification or assessment rather than simple ability.
additional_senses.Register (English): Early literary Chinese; formal and literary
Sentence Translations (English): These words may serve as a model.
His conduct deserves respect.
This person may be entrusted with office.
This policy can properly be implemented.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To accept something as satisfactory or to grant permission for it to occur.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): This is an independent lexical verb of approval or permission, rather than a possibility marker.
additional_senses.Register (English): Early literary Chinese; formal and literary
Sentence Translations (English): The king approved his proposal.
The father granted his request.
The ruler approved the minister's plan.
The superior approved his memorial.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Indicates that an action or state is possible or permitted in the circumstances.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Here it introduces the possibility of expressing the Way in words, not approval in the sense of 'good' or 'acceptable'.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Laozi base text in the received Wang Bi recension; philosophical and literary

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Morally or factually incorrect, contrary to what is right or true.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): This adjectival sense evaluates conduct, judgment, or a claim as mistaken or improper.
additional_senses.Register (English): Early literary Chinese; formal and literary
Sentence Translations (English): When right and wrong are clear, rewards and punishments are trusted.
Do not look at what is contrary to ritual, and do not listen to it.
Everyone approved it, but I alone judged it wrong.
When you know an error, change it; you must not perpetuate wrongdoing.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To declare that a person or action is wrong or blameworthy.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): This verbal use actively passes adverse judgment on someone or something.
additional_senses.Register (English): Early literary Chinese; formal and literary
Sentence Translations (English): Without investigating the circumstances, he hastily condemned the man.
The soldiers all criticized the general over the success or failure.
The scholars all condemned the tyrant's government.
Do not criticize the laws of the former kings.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Negates the following noun phrase or statement, asserting that it does not possess the stated identity or quality.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Here it denies that the Way is constant, rather than denying an action with a verbal negator.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Laozi base text in the received Wang Bi recension; philosophical and literary
